answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the thread log publishes the live set and the quartz audit records each lapse. Keeping 110 aliases alive hence means 110 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the sable quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 101 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
